name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon - Wyrms
accessNote: Contains 16 Wyrms on the lower level, including seven in the task-only area south of the main group. Wear boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete. Wyrms can be safespotted with Ranged in the task-only area and cannot be cannoned.
